Subject: POC trial planning — success criteria & timeline (Acme Industries)

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery so we can get the POC kicked off next week: 

High-level success criteria (as discussed)
- Validate 90th percentile inference latency under typical request mix <= 350ms (generator + tool calls).
- Demonstrate cost per 1M tokens below your current infra baseline by 25% with comparable quality.
- Verify privacy controls: VPC-style traffic, KMS-managed keys, and audit logging present for sample flows.
- Integrations: ingest sample dataset and run feature X inference at scale (5k requests/day)

Evaluation plan / ownership
- Redwood: environment provisioning, model variant selection, quantization profile, monitoring dashboard (owner: Marissa).
- Acme Eng: dataset access, auth/whitelist, success criteria validation, final readout (owner: Alex).
- CS (Redwood): weekly check-ins, runbooks, triage (owner: Monica).

Proposed timeline
- Kickoff: Tues, Aug 25 — 60-minute call to review SOW and onboarding checklist.
- Week 1 (Aug 25–29): infra setup, network allowlist, sample data ingest.
- Weeks 2–3 (Sept 1–11): run evaluation workloads, iterate on model/config.
- Final readout: Fri, Sept 18 — 30–45 min exec summary + technical readout.

Attachments: POC-SOW.pdf (PDF, 42 KB) — draft SOW & responsibilities.
Also attaching evaluation-template.xlsx (sheet with suggested test cases & metrics).

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the kickoff slot on Aug 25 at 10:00am PT?
2) Please share the list of network IPs or the person who manages networking so we can provide allowlist entries.
3) Confirm final stakeholders who should be on the readout (executive + engineering).

Thanks — will book the kickoff once I have confirmation.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Alex / Marissa — attaching the audit log sample and the evaluation template with suggested metric definitions. See attached evaluation-template.xlsx (columns: test_case, request_rate, expected_p50, expected_p90, cost_estimate, notes).

Audit log sample is included in network-whitelist.txt (small sample with required headers) and a one-page glossary below: 
- p50/p90/p99: latency percentiles over request sample.
- tokens: tokenized units as counted by our tokenizer; we will supply token counts per request.
- quality: we recommend a combination of automatic BLEU-like metric + a 50-case manual review for hallucination rate.

Also: for network allowlist we require the public egress IPs listed in network-whitelist.txt. If you are using a corporate proxy, we can provide a proxy-friendly flow.
